text:
Maya (PM): Quick sync — we shipped 1.3 yesterday. Need to agree on iteration focus: stability or feature polish?
Jorge (Eng): saw a spike in 95p latency this morning, investigating. stack traces point to KV cache misses.
Sam (Support): two mid-enterprise customers reported occasional truncation on long chats, assigned CS-842.
Anika (Design): a11y pass for chat UI flagged contrast issues; small cosmetic but legal wants fix.
Ruth (SRE): rolling back a small deploy helped one node recover; deploy-bot: rollback completed at 06:12 UTC :white_check_mark:
Maya (PM): Proposal: prioritize 3 high-impact bugs (latency, truncation, auth flakiness) + one UX polish. Thoughts?
Jorge (Eng): we can triage latency and truncation as hotfixes. Auth flakiness needs more logs — could take 2-3 days.
Anika (Design): UX polish is quick but blocks on copy approval. Can do in one sprint if not blocked.
Sam (Support): customers impacted by truncation are on dedicated plans — escalate for SLA credits if not fixed in 48h.
Maya (PM): OK, can we split into two tracks? Track A: P0/P1 bugs for immediate rollouts. Track B: backlog enhancements and UX polish for next mini-sprint.
Jorge (Eng): Agree. Track A: latency kv-cache fallback improvement (2 dev days), truncation fix (1 day), targeted canary by EOD tomorrow.
Ruth (SRE): For canary, add circuit-breaker and metrics: token-latency by model-version. I'll provision and add Alerts.
Maya (PM): Acceptance criteria for canary: p95 latency < 300ms for 95% of traffic, no truncation incidents for test cohort, observability dashboards updated.
Anika (Design): I'll attach revised copy and contrast patch to the PR. Want shipping together with truncation fix to reduce churn.
Sam (Support): I'll message the affected accounts with ETA and set expectations. Also collect steps to reproduce for truncation reports.
Jorge (Eng): quick patch: inlining small KV warm-on-demand logic. Pushing branch now: git push origin hotfix/kv-warm
Maya (PM): Good. Owner assignments: Jorge owns Track A fixes, Anika owns polish PR, Ruth owns rollout/canary, Sam owns comms.
Maya (PM): Resource ask: if auth flakiness shows up in the canary, we may need to pull in one more eng pair. Jorge ok with that?
Jorge (Eng): yes, pinging @devex for extra bandwidth. Otherwise we can maintain schedule.
Ruth (SRE): I'll create the canary config in the console and tag the rollout with rollback criteria. deploy-bot: start canary when ready.
deploy-bot: Canary job created for team/product/1.3-canary at 07:30 UTC. Monitor channel: #eng-oncall.
Maya (PM): Next steps: 1) Jorge to open PRs for hotfixes by 09:00. 2) Ruth to configure canary + alerts. 3) Sam to notify customers. 4) Anika to finalise copy.
Sam (Support): Noted, will send update to customers and post in #customer-success.
Anika (Design): PR ready, adding accessibility notes.
Jorge (Eng): PRs up: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/1247 and /1248
Maya (PM): We'll re-evaluate after 24h canary. If stable, promote and schedule enhancement wave next sprint. Thanks team :rocket:
Ruth (SRE): I'll post metrics snapshot after 6h and 24h. 
Maya (PM): Great. Closing thread and moving action items into the board. :white_check_mark:
